newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-WEST HAM POISED TO SIGN HUNGARIAN GOALKEEPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEST HAM POISED TO SIGN HUNGARIAN GOALKEEPER.

text.p: English premier league West Ham are poised to sign Hungarian international goalkeeper Szabolcs Safar from Budapest club Vasas.
"Szabolcs has had a number of offers but it seems he has decided on West Ham," Vasas technical director Rudolf Illovszky said on Monday.
"He is in Vienna with his agent and is travelling on to London for a medical test and contract talks with the club."
Safar has been capped six times by Hungary and this summer was linked with Porto, AS Roma and Casino Salzburg.
"This is a great opportunity for me to move to a truly great team." Safar told Hungarian daily Mai Nap.
